theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {γ : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated γ] (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α (γ × ℝ)) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] : ProbabilityTheory.IsRatCondKernelCDF (fun p q => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q)) κ κ.fst := by
  have h_density_nonneg : ∀ p q, 0 ≤ κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q) :=
    κ.density_nonneg _ _
  have h_integral_one : ∫⁻ q in κ.fst : 1 ∂κ.fst = 1 :=
    κ.integral_density _ _
  have h_monotonic : ∀ p q₁ q₂, q₁ ≤ q₂ → κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q₁) ≤ κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q₂) :=
    κ.density_fst_univ _
  have h_right_continuous : ∀ p q, ∀ (s : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ n, s n ≤ q) ∧ limₙ s n = q → tendsto (λ n, κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑(s n))) at_top (κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q)) :=
    κ.setIntegral_density _
  have h_measurable : ∀ p, measurable (fun q => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q)) :=
    κ.measurable_density _
  have h_integrable : ∀ p, ∫⁻ q in κ.fst : κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q) ∂κ.fst = 1 :=
    κ.integral_density _

  exact IsRatCondKernelCDF.mk h_density_nonneg h_integral_one h_monotonic h_right_continuous h_measurable h_integrable
